fields.description:
## Problem
Duplicate tickets are being filed for work that already exists, and the duplication is only
discovered when an agent has already been dispatched and is mid-implementation. Twice in one
session (2026-08-19/20) a duplicate carried the SAME TITLE as its twin and passed creation
unflagged: `elfish-saltwater-pika` (ea16-dd54) and `decagonal-indisposed-tamarin` (baeb-4f4b).
The /rebar-debug Phase-1 investigation (first comment) measured the store: every same-title
true duplicate was created within 171 seconds of its twin, and the constrained detector
"same normalized title + <5 min window" scored 100% precision (7/7) on the full 2679-ticket
store. The operator ruling (2026-08-21 comment) reclassified this bug -> task: absent
create-time detection is intended current behaviour (ADR 0086 placed the heavy overlap
detector at review time, off the hot write path), so this is designed new capability.

## Design — create-time advisory same-title duplicate warning (bounded, O(1))
Matches how mainstream OSS trackers behave (GitHub/GitLab surface similar issues at filing
time; Kubernetes/VS Code triage bots flag likely duplicates immediately after creation):
detection at CREATE, advisory-only (never blocks), reusing cheap existing signals.

**Mechanism.** A small rolling "recent creates" journal — a store-wide sidecar
(`StorePaths(tracker).sidecar("recent-creates.json")`, the same canonical-store keying the
overlap enrich gate marker uses, bug da68-fc7c) — records `{ts_ns, id, alias, title,
title_norm}` for each create and is pruned to a fixed recency window (600 s, ~3.5x the
largest observed true-duplicate delta of 171 s). On every create, `create_core` probes the
journal for a normalized-title match (case/punctuation/whitespace folded) BEFORE appending
its own entry, then rewrites the journal atomically (temp file + `os.replace`, the gate-marker
pattern). Cost is one small-file read + one write — O(window), never O(store); no title index,
no store scan, honouring the moist-short-lionfish write-path budget lesson (bug 6148 class).
On a match, the single candidate ticket is reduced (one-ticket `reduce_ticket`, O(1)) to
report its LIVE status in the message.

**Gating.** The probe runs only when `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` is true — the
existing advisory duplicate-detection key (on for this project), so no new config surface.
Flag off = no journal, no probe, zero write-path footprint.

**Surfacing (the description_cap_warning pattern, ticket 594b).** `create_core` returns a new
`duplicate_warning` key; each surface emits it on its own channel after the write commits:
CLI stderr via `_warn_stderr` (stdout stays pure in both output modes), library logger +
`duplicate_warning` in the `return_alias=True` dict, MCP `CreateResultOut.duplicate_warning`
field. The message names the candidate's id/alias, its current status, the age of its create,
and states the create still succeeded (advisory, exit 0 / no error). Every failure inside the
probe (unreadable journal, config error, reduce failure) degrades to no-warning — an advisory
must never fail a completed write.

**Portability.** The trigger is operation-linked and in-process (inside `create_core`, the
single seam every create funnels through: CLI, library, MCP, `idea()`); no CI dependency.

**Secondary AC (duplicates links for the two named tickets).** Phase-1 proved the sanctioned
post-close path works end-to-end: `reopen -> link <src> <target> duplicates -> transition
open closed --class duplicate` (the re-close is exempt from completion verification via the
`_administrative_disposition` short-circuit). No code change; execute that runnable path on
`elfish-saltwater-pika` -> `woodblock-gnatty-xiaosaurus` (5a90-ec98) and
`decagonal-indisposed-tamarin` -> `039b-d179-b669-4439` so both carry machine-readable
`duplicates` links.

## File impact
- `src/rebar/_commands/recent_creates.py` (new): journal read/prune/append + probe +
  `duplicate_create_warning`.
- `src/rebar/_commands/composer.py`: call the probe in `create_core` beside
  `description_cap_warning`; CLI stderr emit in `create_cli`.
- `src/rebar/_lib_writes.py`: log + carry `duplicate_warning` on `create_ticket`/`idea`.
- `src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py`, `src/rebar/_mcp_models.py`: MCP result field.
- `src/rebar/types.py`, `src/rebar/schemas/create_result.schema.json`: result shape.
- `docs/config.md`: note the create-time advisory under `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets`.
- `tests/unit/test_create_duplicate_warning.py` (new).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Establish and record whether `rebar create` currently consults the overlap detector, with the
      file and line that does or does not. (Answered by Phase-1: it does NOT —
      `create_core`, `src/rebar/_commands/composer.py:113-281`, no `rebar.llm.overlap` import;
      record the final line numbers in the close comment.)
- [ ] A ticket whose title matches an existing ticket's is SURFACED at creation time — the author is
      told, with the candidate ticket's id and status. Proven by creating a same-title ticket in a
      test and asserting the signal appears. Title match is the minimum bar (normalized: case,
      punctuation, whitespace folded), bounded to the 600 s recency window per the measured design.
- [ ] The signal does not block creation. Legitimate same-title tickets exist (follow-ups, retries,
      per-environment variants); the requirement is that the author is INFORMED, not prevented —
      exit code 0, ticket created, warning on stderr/logger/result-field only.
- [ ] `rebar link <closed-source> <target> duplicates` is permitted, or a sanctioned alternative
      exists for recording a duplicate relation after the source is closed. Whichever is chosen,
      `elfish-saltwater-pika` and `decagonal-indisposed-tamarin` end up with machine-readable
      `duplicates` links rather than prose comments. (Sanctioned alternative proven by Phase-1:
      reopen -> link -> re-close `--class duplicate`; execute it on both tickets.)
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass; `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`
      reports `new=0 increased=0`.

## Testing / Verification
- RED-first unit tests in `tests/unit/test_create_duplicate_warning.py` (modeled on
  `test_description_cap_warning.py`): same-title create within the window warns with the
  candidate's id and status on all three surfaces (library dict, CLI stderr with pure
  stdout, MCP result field); distinct titles are silent; normalization folds
  case/punctuation/whitespace; an entry older than the window is silent; flag off = silent
  and no journal writes; a corrupt journal never fails the create; the warned create still
  succeeds (exit 0, ticket readable).
- Gates: `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`, `make typecheck`,
  `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_create_duplicate_warning.py tests/unit/test_description_cap_warning.py -q`,
  `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` (new=0 increased=0).
- Manual: in a scratch store with `REBAR_VERIFY_SUGGEST_DUPLICATE_TICKETS=1`, create two
  tickets with the same title seconds apart and observe the stderr advisory naming the first.
